question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `mcp.servers.*.oauth.authProfileId` as a higher-precedence alternate MCP credential source and permit its current access token in local Codex thread configuration?
rationale: The reported bug can be fixed for existing `openclaw mcp login` credentials without adding this lasting public config and security-boundary contract, so implementation correctness alone cannot decide the permanent surface.

options.title: Keep the alternate selector
options.body: Retain and document `oauth.authProfileId` precedence and local-only token projection after the refresh race is fixed and live proof is supplied.

options.title: Narrow to MCP-native OAuth
options.body: Remove the new selector and land only projection of credentials already created by `openclaw mcp login`.

options.title: Pause for credential redesign
options.body: Defer this branch until maintainers choose a different shared credential abstraction for MCP runtimes.

recommendation.title: Keep the alternate selector
recommendation.body: Retain and document `oauth.authProfileId` precedence and local-only token projection after the refresh race is fixed and live proof is supplied.
